# Module: `icescopy_inptk_state`

Stores analysis choices and translates them into toolkit command arguments.

[Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_state.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Defines defaults, reconciles choices with the sample catalogue, validates group membership, and assigns selected water blanks. Builds commands for calculation and range suggestions. Direct individual comparisons use separate Average choices without combination limits. An absent manual boundary is left for the toolkit to resolve.
